title: A companion
for legal strategy.
hero.tagline: The legal AI that verifies before it answers.
hero.quote: The best lawyers are strategists. They read the client, the regulator, the court. Fluso clears everything in the way of that work.

pillars.title: It reasons like a lawyer.
pillars.body:
A reasoning engine built for legal strategy. Every authority is checked against the governing source, unsupported statements are surfaced, and every conclusion traces to the material it rests on. 
 You see the path, not just the answer.

pillars.title: It works on privileged information.
pillars.body: Fluso ingests and operates on privileged information inside a hardware-encrypted perimeter. Your infrastructure provider can’t read it. Neither can we.

features.title: Research you can build on
features.body: Ask a legal question and receive a structured analysis with every proposition sourced and the primary materials attached.

features.title: Strategy for the room
features.body: Counterarguments, jurisdictional conflicts, and reasoning gaps are surfaced before they surface in front of a counterparty.

features.title: Honest about uncertainty
features.body: If the law is unsettled, you are told it is unsettled, and you decide how to proceed.

features.title: Jurisdiction-aware
features.body: Fluso knows which source governs for each jurisdiction, and checks against it.

title: Multi-jurisdictional work
across 12+ practice areas.
practiceAreas.lead: For your firm’s own precedent, we build custom connectors to your DMS and knowledge systems, so the workspace reasons over your institutional knowledge, inside your perimeter.

fragments.title: Confidential compute
fragments.body: A hardware-encrypted perimeter. Your provider can’t read your data in use. Neither can we.

fragments.title: Deploy where your obligations require
fragments.body: Your cloud, your VPC, on-premise, or air-gapped.

fragments.title: Your data is yours
fragments.body: Never trains shared models. Isolated workspaces. Full audit trail. Export anytime.

fragments.title: Built for privileged work
fragments.body: Designed for the most sensitive matters a firm holds.
